title: Tail Chaser Carolina Beach Fishing Charter
specs: Captain Brandon Phillips has lifelong North Carolina fishing experience
Boat is 38’ Luhrs with twin Cummins 450 HP Diesel engines, bunks, restroom, and latest electronics
No fishing license needed; operator has blanket license
Maximum 6 passengers per trip per U.S. Coast Guard
includes: All bait, tackle and ice provided
blurb: Guests fish for various species including Spanish Mackerel, Bluefish, Trout, Seabass, Flounder, Grouper, Cobia, Amberjacks, Mahi, King Mackerel, Snapper, Tuna, Wahoo, Sailfish, and Barracuda. Trips range from nearshore trolling to offshore and Gulf Stream fishing. The boat is a 38’ Luhrs with modern electronics, bunks, and restroom.
extraNote: $200 deposit required to reserve trip · Cancel with 7 days notice for no charge or reschedule · Trip canceled by captain due to weather or unforeseen circumstances results in no charge · No fuel surcharge or hidden fees · 3.5% convenience fee for credit card payments · Tips of 15-20% of charter rate appreciated for mate · 300 Canal Dr, Slip 22, Carolina Beach, NC 28428
